text.description_html:
3 Inch Clearwater Acrylic Glass Mounted Shower Hook with Screw Cover

The Clearwater Shower Hook comes packaged with everything you need to install on a glass shower door including a screw cover. The acrylic has a 1 inch diameter and is hand chiseled so it looks like flowing water. The mount is made out of solid brass and as such, is available in a huge selection of finish options. This 3 inch Acrylic Shower Hook can be mounted either vertically so it can be used to hang towels and robes or horizontally so it can be used as a shower door pull.

Features and Specifications of the Clearwater Acrylic Robe Hook:

  • Pull Material: Hand Chiseled Clear Acrylic
  • Pull Mount Material: Solid Brass
  • Overall Length: 3"
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Clearance: 1.69"
  • Screw Cover Outside Diameter: 1"
  • Screw Cover Projection: 1/4"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
  • Hole in Glass: 3/8" to 1/2" Diameter

Packaged with one (1) pull thru-bolt mounted with matching screw cover.
